subject.title: Feature: preserve completed progress draft in Telegram progress mode

question: Should Telegram progress mode gain a default-off option that preserves the full completed progress draft, including checklist-style state, while sending the final answer as a separate normal message?
rationale: Current main already keeps a compact summary after final delivery, but preserving the whole progress card changes Telegram lifecycle behavior and adds public config surface, which repository policy treats as product-sensitive.

options.title: Accept default-off full draft preservation
options.body: Add a documented Telegram-owned keep-on-complete/finalization option while preserving the current one-line collapse summary as the default.

options.title: Keep current collapse summary only
options.body: Treat the existing one-line residual summary as the supported final state and decline full completed-draft preservation for now.

options.title: Defer to structured progress cards
options.body: Track checklist-style retention as part of a broader structured progress-card API instead of adding a Telegram-only lifecycle flag now.

recommendation.title: Accept default-off full draft preservation
recommendation.body: Add a documented Telegram-owned keep-on-complete/finalization option while preserving the current one-line collapse summary as the default.
